timing: Frozen after the dfe56d8 route-diagnostic checkpoint and before any post-amendment quality outcome was generated or inspected.
diagnosis: Long S4 Markdown embedded in a JSON string caused malformed or truncated worker envelopes despite usable memo text.
Free-form graph selection required each worker model to reproduce opaque ledger IDs and caused unknown-ID, over-selection, and selector-cap failures.
Long JSON working-set compilation measured provider schema compliance rather than governed-handoff task quality.

corrections.s4_transport: Return the complete final memo as Markdown directly; S4 conclusions are not used after the receiver boundary.
corrections.graph_selection: Deterministically select current admitted ledger receipts from the trusted-context projection, using only actual IDs and a fixed maximum of 48.
corrections.working_set: Render each selected conclusion, evidence filename, and bounded extracted evidence locally; do not ask the worker model to regenerate IDs or a JSON graph envelope.
corrections.sender_structure: Keep S1-S3 JSON but add fixed concision limits; legacy frozen sender responses remain parse-compatible and may be reused.
corrections.attempts: Every provider or worker failure creates a new explicitly numbered attempt; no automatic retry or fallback is introduced.

claim_boundary: Post-amendment panels estimate the governed-handoff treatment with deterministic context assembly. They must not be pooled silently with pre-amendment panels, and all prior invalid attempts remain route-reliability evidence.
